title: The Ritual of Uth'okk
wikitext: {{Questbox | name=The Ritual of Uth'okk | start=[[Far Seer Mothang]] | faction=Horde | id=41731 | level=38 | category=Grim Reaches | experience = 300 | reputation = +300 [[Orgrimmar (faction)|Orgrimmar]] | previous = [[The Power of Uth'okk]] | rewards = [[The Pendant of Uth'okk]] }} == Objectives == Wait for Far Seer Mothang to finish his ritual. * Wait for Far Seer Mothang to finish his ritual == Description == All of the materials have been gathered, We have come to the culmination of our efforts. If we want to truly harness such energy we must first find a suitable conduit for which to contain it. Long ago a great gemstone of immense power was brought to this world by Gul'dan and his minions. The Pendant of Uth'okk was left to Oronok Torn-Heart, one of Gul'dan's lieutenants. It is this pendant that I seek. You can find him lurking within the depths of Stormwrought Ruins on the island of Balor. This will not be an easy task, but I desire you to kill him, and bring me the power of the Pendant of Uth'okk. Do this, and you shall be rewarded. ==Rewards== You will receive: * [[The Pendant of Uth'okk]] * 300 XP == Progress == == Completion == The power of the Uth'okk gemstone is flowing through my veins... Such power is euphoric! I am reborn, and I have you to thank for doing all my work. The Pendant of Uth'okk has been sapped of its power, but I am sure you can make some use of it. Farewell . ==Notes== [[File:Mothang ritual.png|thumb|Far Seer Mothang after having completed the ritual.]] ;On accept :Far Seer Mothang begins the ritual. :'''Far Seer Mothang says:''' I can feel the power flowing through my veins! :''Far Seer Mothang turns red and increases in size.'' :'''Far Seer Mothang says:''' It is complete!
